messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: org_id=iodinecorp experiencing sustained request QPS spike and 5xx rate >8% over 3m. Route: text-generation-east-1, model: redwood-7b-v1. Tripped auto-throttles on a subset of routes. (alert_id=inc-2024-iodine-01)
alex: oncall here — pulling dashboard now. Can someone post the customer impact?
maria: IodineCorp support ticket shows timeouts from their side API calls ~12:12 UTC. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.io/orgs/iodinecorp/traffic (high p50/p95 latency, drop in success rate). Looks like heavy burst on embed+generate route combo.
tariq: probable feedback loop from client retry logic. They're hitting long-context generates and small batch size. Suggest 1) temp per-org soft-rate cap 2) disable long-context premium pipeline for that org 3) notify customer to patch retries.
samir: If we disable premium pipeline we'll reduce cost and token churn quickly. How fast can we flip the feature flag?
alex: I can push a targeted feature gate now — but prefer to also add a temporary rate cap so we don't lose availability for others. Applying soft cap 60s window.
alex: command: `redwoodctl org update-rate --org iodinecorp --limit 1200r/m --window 60s --reason "emergency surge containment"`
incident-bot: Action recorded: org update-rate called by alex at 1719876605. New soft cap 1200r/m applied to iodinecorp.
maria: After cap applied latency p95 dropped ~22% in 30s, errors down to 4.5%. Looks like it's buying time.
product-ops: what's the customer SLA class? Any contractual implications to adjusting rate without notice?
support-jen: I have the account owner on standby, messaging them now: "We're observing a traffic anomaly and applying a temporary protective rate cap to stabilize service. We'll follow up with details and recommended client-side retry/backoff changes."
samir: Also toggled premium pipeline off for iodinecorp — command: `redwoodctl flags set --org iodinecorp --flag premium_pipeline --value off`
incident-bot: Feature flag change recorded by samir at 1719876622. Premium pipeline disabled for iodinecorp.
tariq: Good. Next: consider increasing cache TTL on common prefixes for that org and enable aggressive response caching for embeddings. That should reduce duplicate compute.
alex: Doing cache TTL change now: `redwoodctl org cache-config --org iodinecorp --prefix-ttl 300s`
alex: Updated. Monitoring impact.
maria: Metrics: token consumption down ~35%, p95 latency now normalizing ~15%. Errors ~2.1%. Customer requests are being processed but at degraded throughput.
product-ops: Prepare incident summary for postmortem: root cause hypothesis = client retry amplification + long-context premium pipeline causing token-explosive workloads. Mitigations = soft cap, premium pipeline disable, cache TTL bump, customer notification.
support-jen: IodineCorp replied: "Thanks — we saw a config bug that retried indefinitely. We'll deploy a fix and throttle on our side." They've requested confirmation when we re-enable premium pipeline.
tariq: We'll need a cautious rollback plan: 1) monitor for 15m after re-enable 2) re-enable premium pipeline to a small % (canary) 3) ramp if stable.
alex: Noted. I'll do canary at 10% traffic via rollout: `redwoodctl rollout feature --org iodinecorp --flag premium_pipeline --pct 10 --duration 15m`
incident-bot: Rollout initiated by alex at 1719876660. Canary 10% scheduled for 15m.
maria: After the canary start metrics look stable for the subset — p95 within baseline. Support confirmed client's fix deployed.
samir: Increasing canary to 50% now.
alex: Canary at 50%. Watching queues and latency.
maria: Good signals. No error spike so far.
product-ops: We should keep the soft cap in place for another hour and then remove if stable. Also add follow-up item to add org-specific backpressure signals to alerting.
support-jen: Customer thanked us and asked for an incident writeup and next steps. I'll create a ticket and loop in AM support.
alex: Removing soft cap at 1719876678 as we see sustained stability. Command: `redwoodctl org update-rate --org iodinecorp --remove-soft-cap`
incident-bot: Soft cap removed by alex at 1719876678.
maria: Final status: premium pipeline fully re-enabled, p95 within target, errors <1%. Marking incident as mitigated.
product-ops: Thanks team — please file postmortem with timeline, commands run, and recommendations (client retries guidance, per-org alert tuning).
alex: Filed initial incident note: https://incidents.redwood.io/1719876543 — will populate full postmortem tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
support-jen: Sent customer follow-up with summary and recommended client backoff changes.
incident-bot: Incident inc-2024-iodine-01 status changed to MITIGATED at 1719876680 by alex."
